customization.summary: Beta dedicated Sandbox: fixed 4 vCPU/8 GB, packages/configuration reusable in persistent home. Official SDK image_uri exists, but product guide prohibits startup customization; image deployability unresolved.

features.notes: Official EnvironmentSpec.image_uri accepts a Unity Catalog container artifact in schema; current product guide says startup customization unavailable. Field existence is not verified workspace acceptance or arbitrary registry-image support.
Product guide explicitly allows packages/configuration stored in home for cross-session reuse; system-image/root customization not promised.
Fixed 4 vCPU, not configurable. ComputeSpec exposes inactivity timeout, not vCPU selection.
No selectable accelerator in current fixed CPU Sandbox offering or inspected SDK compute contract.
Unrestricted outbound egress is explicitly non-configurable; default ingress closed and non-configurable. New system.ai.sandbox MCP has different no-egress posture.
100 GB /home/sandbox-agent persists across stop/start until delete; up to 10 GB outside home lost on stop, including adapter /tmp staging. Possible Beta-end purge.
Named sandbox reuse and stop/start documented. Not a memory/process checkpoint guarantee; adapter creates per execution and deletes, so reuse untested.
Direct exec via SDK name/cmd; /bin/bash -c plus SSH. Adapter keywords corrected and Duration execution timeout forwarded; configured workspace reports API unavailable, so shell not freshly verified.
Command/stdin/stdout or SSH-based transfer; no native file endpoint in inspected SDK. Adapter base64-stages inputs but collector returns []; historical artifact result unresolved.
Documented SSH -L local forwarding; not public preview URLs. Public ingress closed/non-configurable.
Managed serverless execution; SDK/CLI are clients, not self-hosted backend.
No dedicated Sandbox key configuration or encryption-key coverage verified. Adapter false is not authoritative exclusion.
